Those are generated files: the second PR to land regenerates them through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. #21261 (`i18n-resolver.ts`) is queued and not claimed; it now waits behind this card. `migrations/registry.ts` holds orders 57–59 on `main`; this card takes the next free order, re-read on `main` at the edit.
